text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ickhkeul park in northern Tunisia is the most visited park in the country.
- Maltese businessmen expected in Tunisia on February 25 for talks with their Tunisian counterparts.
- New legislation protecting intellectual property goes into effect. It is a turning point for firms manufacturing recording tapes.
- Black and Decker to open a representation office based in Tunis and covering North Africa.
- Twenty university centres to be created by the year 2010.
- A Tuinisian-European chamber of commerce to be set up.
